title: Kosher Haddock Crisp
description: A savory, crunchy indulgent Russian dish featuring haddock, deglazed with a simple sauce, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: White wine or Kosher Chicken Broth

instructions: Mix haddock fillets with flour, paprika, and a pinch of salt. Shake off excess.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned haddock and fry until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
In another pan or pot, deglaze with white wine or broth. Add lemon juice and dill; bring to a simmer for a few seconds to combine flavors.
Pour the sauce over the fried haddock fillets, letting them absorb the flavor on all sides.
Transfer fillets to a baking dish lined with parchment paper. Bake in preheated oven until crispy, about 10 minutes.
